description: sudo without a password for the box user: any program in a box can then become root

steps.name: A sudo rule for the box user, checked before it is put in place
steps.run: rule=/etc/sudoers.d/agent-vm; printf '%s ALL=(ALL:ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL\n' "$AGENT_VM_BOX_USER" > "$rule.new" && chmod 440 "$rule.new" && visudo -c -q -f "$rule.new" && mv -f "$rule.new" "$rule" && visudo -c -q || { rm -f "$rule.new" "$rule"; echo 'the sudo rule was refused' >&2; exit 1; }

checks: sudo -n true && echo "no password is asked of $(id -un)"
